name: effort-pilot
description: Picks the effort level per prompt (with your approval unless auto-approve is on), lets Claude switch effort mid-turn, and trims token waste without changing outcomes.

autoApprove.title: Auto-approve effort changes
autoApprove.description: Apply the pilot's picks and Claude's set_effort requests without asking.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: heuristic = free, local rules. hybrid = also asks Haiku (low effort) when the rules are unsure.

minLevel.title: Lowest effort the pilot may pick
minLevel.description: Floor for picks; raise it if low ever feels too thin.

maxLevel.title: Highest effort the pilot may pick
maxLevel.description: Ceiling for picks; the pilot only goes past high on strong signals.

trimBashChars.title: Trim Bash output over N chars (0 = off)
trimBashChars.description: Keeps head + tail for the model; the full output is saved to a file it can read.

readGuardLines.title: Guard whole-file Reads over N lines (0 = off)
readGuardLines.description: First whole read of a big file is bounced once with its size; repeating the call reads it.

leanPrompt.title: Add the lean-work rules to the system prompt
leanPrompt.description: About 60 tokens of efficiency rules, sent after the cache boundary.

spillDir.title: Where trimmed Bash output is saved
spillDir.description: Folder for full Bash outputs the pilot trimmed.
